runners_data.note: Highest-rated horse who can lead or sit prominent and has strong recent 7f form on this surface

runners_data.name: Dontspoilasale
runners_data.note: Natural pace angle but lacks a recent win and may struggle against stronger opposition

runners_data.name: Benavente
runners_data.note: Classic closer who won last start over 7f and thrives when allowed to come from behind

runners_data.name: Una Matata
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer with good recent 7f third who needs steady early pace

runners_data.name: Ruff Justice
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up horse with solid going record but modest recent form suggests vulnerability

runners_data.name: Thaloria
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced prominent runner who won over course and distance last time out

runners_data.name: Suerte
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer but lacks a win and may find this company too strong

runners_data.name: Crest Of Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from heavy ground defeat who needs everything to fall right

races.paceDynamic: The Liffey and Dontspoilasale will likely share early leadership with Thaloria and Suerte sitting close behind this modest pace. With no confirmed speed horses, this sets up as a steady gallop that will favor the closers in the final 2f when the prominent runners come under pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Speed Holds
scenarios.trigger: If The Liffey or Dontspoilasale can dictate a comfortable tempo without serious pressure.
scenarios.body: The leaders get first run and maintain their advantage as the closers struggle to make up ground in time. Superior class tells when not softened up by fierce pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Perfect Closer Setup
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian with multiple horses tracking closely behind the leaders.
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo suits the hold-up horses who unleash telling late runs in the final furlong. Benavente and Una Matata capitalize on their superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Thaloria or Suerte can position perfectly just behind the leaders and strike first.
scenarios.body: The tactical speed of the prominent runners catches both leaders and closers at the wrong moment. Quick acceleration from an ideal stalking position proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early fractions are unusually slow and multiple horses are still in contention at the furlong pole.
scenarios.body: A blanket finish develops where any horse can win based on who gets the clearest run. The race becomes a sprint finish lottery among tired horses.

watchPoints.text: Watch if The Liffey gets an uncontested lead as superior class could prove decisive
Monitor early positioning of Benavente and Una Matata as they need cover and clear running room
Observe how quickly Thaloria breaks from the stalls after her impressive last victory here
Check if Dontspoilasale shows early speed or gets shuffled back in a slowly-run affair
Watch for traffic problems in the straight as multiple hold-up horses will need room simultaneously

runners_data.name: Spinning Around
runners_data.note: Forward-going sort with good recent win at this distance and strong good ground record

runners_data.name: Venetian
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with solid good ground form and regular place-getting ability

runners_data.name: Blue Anthem
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with three wins from good ground form who needs pace to collapse

runners_data.name: Um Wadi
runners_data.note: Closer who lacks recent wins but has shown ability at this level on similar ground

runners_data.name: Nikki Swango
runners_data.note: Strong closer with four wins on good ground who excels when getting a true gallop

runners_data.name: Whistling Jamesie

races.paceDynamic: Bishopton will lead or share the early pace with Musical Act, Spinning Around and Venetian all wanting prominent positions behind them. This creates a moderate tempo with four hold-up horses (Blue Anthem, Um Wadi, Nikki Swango, Whistling Jamesie) relying on the pace collapsing in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet maintain a solid gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The pace doesn't collapse enough for the hold-up brigade to make significant inroads. Bishopton or one of the other prominent runners kicks clear in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady allowing closers to get into contention
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup as the pace slackens after halfway. Nikki Swango or Blue Anthem produce telling late runs to overhaul the early leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Group Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too hard early and tie up
scenarios.body: The pace-setters burn each other out leaving the door open for late runners. The hold-up horses benefit from a strongly-run race that sees the leaders fade dramatically in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If positioning becomes messy with no clear pace angle
scenarios.body: Several horses get compromised by the lack of rhythm and true pace. An opportunistic prominent runner like Spinning Around or Venetian capitalizes on the tactical confusion.

watchPoints.text: Whistling Jamesie has a pattern of fading in the final furlong which could be exposed in a competitive handicap like this
If Bishopton gets an uncontested lead the moderate early pace could make it difficult for hold-up horses to peg back
Um Wadi needs a strong gallop throughout but may struggle if the pace becomes stop-start tactical
Blue Anthem's three good ground wins suggest this surface change from recent soft ground runs could unlock improvement
Musical Act needs to bounce back from disappointing recent efforts but has the tactical speed to stay involved

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Wind will dictate from the front with minimal pressure, likely joined by Comfort Line and Jazzy Dancer in the early stages. With most of the field preferring to settle back, this creates a sustainable pace that will favor those who can position prominently without over-racing. The large contingent of hold-up horses will face a tactical challenge if the pace becomes too steady.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind controls uncontested fractions and the field settles
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up brigade to make meaningful ground late. Jazzy Dancer and Comfort Line can track the leader and kick clear when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Comfort Line and Jazzy Dancer pressure Son Of Wind early creating a true test
scenarios.body: The sustained pace sets up perfectly for closers with stamina reserves. Roman Harry and Jasmine Affanalis can unleash devastating late runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind goes too slow and the field bunches approaching the turn
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where positioning becomes crucial and several can win. Manhattan Dandy gets a dream trip while Sakakawea finds gaps.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Solo
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind gets completely uncontested splits and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds an unassailable lead that holds despite late challenges. Comfort Line provides the main threat but cannot get close enough.

watchPoints.text: Vibrato and Qvee both show clear patterns of fading in the finish and may stop quickly if pressured late
If Son Of Wind gets loose on the lead with soft fractions, the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground
Comfort Line and Jazzy Dancer must avoid going too hard chasing Son Of Wind early or they'll compromise their finish
Manhattan Dandy needs the pace to collapse into a sprint to have any realistic winning chance
Roman Harry and Jasmine Affanalis require genuine pace pressure throughout to maximize their closing kicks

races.paceDynamic: Jazz Forever appears the sole natural leader but carries a warning flag for fading in the finish, suggesting he may set up the race without lasting home. With Numidia, Hobart and Circus Act as the only prominent racers, this creates a tactical affair where the large hold-up contingent including Mephisto, Slowdownbarney and Disco Boy will need the pace to collapse late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jazz Forever Burns Out
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever sets his usual strong pace but fades as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The early leader's collapse creates a sprint finish where the strongest closer can capitalize on the setup. Hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever is restrained or the prominent runners decline to engage early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes painfully slow with everyone waiting, turning it into a pure sprint from the final three furlongs. The horse with the best turn of foot wins.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Numidia or Hobart press Jazz Forever from early and maintain strong pace throughout
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop stretches the field and finds out the weaker horses, with only the most genuine stayers lasting home. Recent form and class tell.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is reasonable but Jazz Forever and prominent runners all fade simultaneously from halfway
scenarios.body: Creates a messy race where position becomes crucial and any horse tracking the pace can inherit the lead. Form goes out the window.

watchPoints.text: Jazz Forever's stamina reserves - if he maintains pace to the final furlong instead of fading, he wins easily
How aggressively Numidia and Hobart engage from the start - their decisions shape the entire race tempo
Slowdownbarney's position tracking into the straight - needs to be close enough when the pace collapses
Desert Friend's ability to handle a truly-run race given his recent winning form over shorter
Whether Disco Boy can overcome his poor record on similar going despite his class advantage

runners_data.name: Arrowstock
runners_data.note: Lightly raced unknown quantity whose running style and going preferences remain unclear

runners_data.name: Whammy
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will dictate terms but must prove stamina after recent fourth

runners_data.name: Belle Island
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who ran well on debut and should benefit from the racing experience

runners_data.name: Brazilian Diva
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer needing gaps and pace collapse to be effective over this sharp 5f

runners_data.name: Lamar River
runners_data.note: Outclassed hold-up horse whose recent poor form suggests limited winning chance

races.paceDynamic: Whammy will lead uncontested from the gates with Maria Quiteria and Belle Island settling prominently behind. With only one natural front runner and two prominent runners, the pace will be comfortable early before quickening from 2f out as the hold-up horses Brazilian Diva and Lamar River attempt to close.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Whammy gets easy fractions and kicks clear 2f out
scenarios.body: The lone front runner builds an unassailable lead as the field struggles to close the gap in time. Maria Quiteria rallies for second but cannot match Whammy's tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Takes Over
scenarios.trigger: If Maria Quiteria and Belle Island pressure Whammy from 3f out
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners overwhelm the tiring leader in the final furlong with superior acceleration. Brazilian Diva emerges late but falls just short of the leading pair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Brazilian Diva gets the perfect trip tracking the pace
scenarios.body: The hold-up runner finds gaps and delivers a sustained finish to collar the early leaders. Whammy weakens after leading too long while the prominent runners lack a final kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Arrowstock shows unexposed ability from a prominent position
scenarios.body: The lightly raced runner produces untapped potential to outfinish more experienced rivals. The established front and prominent runners set it up perfectly for fresh legs.

watchPoints.text: Whammy must break alertly to secure the lead as any early pressure will compromise his stamina
Brazilian Diva needs the pace to collapse and clear gaps to emerge late - watch for traffic problems
Maria Quiteria's early positioning will be crucial as she needs to avoid getting trapped behind a slow pace
Belle Island showed promise on debut but must handle any increased pace pressure from prominent berth
Arrowstock is the complete unknown - watch for any market moves indicating hidden ability

races.paceDynamic: Wild Sapphire and Nelliestar are the only horses with prominent running styles, but Nelliestar's poor form means Wild Sapphire will likely dictate from the front uncontested. With 10 hold-up horses crammed behind, this creates a tactical nightmare where positioning and timing become critical, favoring those who can find clear runs when the pace lifts in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Sapphire gets an easy lead and the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: Wild Sapphire controls the tempo and has enough left to resist late challengers who get caught in traffic. The combination of sustainable fractions and crowded closers plays into the leader's hands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If Poet's Willow gets a clear run and doesn't fade as usual
scenarios.body: The superior OR=120 rating proves decisive as Poet's Willow finds gaps that lesser horses cannot exploit. Hold-up style suits the likely scenario but stamina questions remain.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maiden Form Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gaiety Girl gets prominent early position behind Wild Sapphire and avoids trouble
scenarios.body: The only winner in the field shows her class by tracking the leader and having the tactical advantage over the deep closers. Her proven good going form and tactical speed separate her from the pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the fancied runners get trapped while an outsider finds clear passage
scenarios.body: Pedro The Poet or Grecian Power benefit from the cavalry charge as better-fancied hold-up horses get shuffled back. The wide-open nature of the finish creates opportunities for patient rides on unconsidered runners.

watchPoints.text: Poet's Willow's jockey positioning early - needs to be handy enough to avoid the traffic jam but not so keen he fades again
Wild Sapphire's fractions through halfway - if allowed to crawl she becomes very dangerous to peg back
How many runners try to improve position turning into straight - mass movement could compromise several chances
Gaiety Girl's early tactical position - must track Wild Sapphire rather than get swallowed up in the pack
The draw impact on the hold-up horses - inside berths could prove crucial for finding racing room

races.paceDynamic: Rising Sky will be the sole pace-setter with On The Cards, Barretstown, and Rushford likely tracking in second and third positions. With no pace pressure from other front runners, Rising Sky can dictate a steady tempo that should favor the strong-traveling hold-up horses like Storm Eric, Star Mind, and Captain Hanley who can unleash late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Rising Sky maintains an even gallop without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setters get first run on the field and the strong tempo doesn't compromise their stamina reserves. Storm Eric and Star Mind find traffic problems when trying to deliver their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian allowing closers to wind up
scenarios.body: Storm Eric and Star Mind get perfect setups to unleash their trademark late runs from the back of the field. Captain Hanley also benefits from the tactical scenario but may lack the class to match the top two.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rushford Fades Early
scenarios.trigger: If Rushford's known finishing weakness shows and creates gaps in the prominent group
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong creating opportunities for any horse with reserve stamina. Rising Sky capitalizes on the weakening of his main early rivals while Storm Eric picks up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Barretstown Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Barretstown's recent improvement continues and the pace suits his prominent style perfectly
scenarios.body: The consistent performer gets an ideal trip just behind Rising Sky and outstays his rivals in the closing stages. His superior fitness and tactical position overcome the class deficit against higher-rated opponents.

watchPoints.text: Rising Sky setting too strong an early pace could compromise his stamina reserves over this extended trip
Storm Eric and Star Mind getting boxed in behind the small early pace group as they need clear runs to be effective
Rushford fading earlier than usual which could create gaps and change the pace dynamics significantly
Captain Hanley's positioning in the early stages as he needs to be handy enough to strike
How aggressively On The Cards and Barretstown track Rising Sky in the opening half-mile
